pairs.question: Quid nobis profuit superbia aut quid divitiarum iactatio contulit nobis?
pairs.answer: Transierunt omnia illa tamquam umbra et tamquam nuntius percurrens.
pairs.derivation: Within the lament of the wicked (5:3 dicent inter se). The interrogative is verse 8 in full ('what did pride profit us, or what did the boast of riches bring us?'); verse 9 answers it ('all those things passed away like a shadow') and the answer ends at the first full stop, before the verse-10 elaboration with further similes (navis, avis, sagitta). pairs.question: Quis enim dicet tibi quid fecisti aut quis stabit contra iudicium tuum aut quis in conspectum tuum veniet vindex iniquorum hominum aut quis tibi inputabit si nationes perierint quas tu fecisti?
pairs.answer: Nec enim est alius Deus quam tu cuius cura est de omnibus ut ostendas quoniam non iniuste iudicasti.
pairs.derivation: Address to God. Verse 12 is a chain of interrogatives asking who could call God to account; verse 13 answers ('for there is no other God than you...'), and the answer ends at the verse-13 full stop, before verse 14 ('neque rex neque tyrannus...') which elaborates further.
